tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event at an ISO 8601 time with an explicit UTC offset. This does not send invitations.

tools.name: send_invitation
tools.description: Send one invitation for an existing calendar event to one email address. Each call sends a separate invitation.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Read an existing calendar event without modifying it or sending invitations.

events.content: Use the available tools to carry out the request. Call one tool at a time. Use tool results to decide what to do next. Give a final response that accurately describes completed actions and failures.

Invite dana@example.invalid to existing event EV-17 first, then invite priya@example.invalid. Attempt each address once even if one fails. Do not retry or create an event. Tell me the result for each address.
